Happy Birthday,
Seony.

October 14, 2026

I made this little place for you because I couldn't be beside you today.

01 · BEFORE I KNEW YOU

Look at you…

You were already cute before I even knew you existed. 😭

02 · SOMEHOW, I FOUND YOU

And then somehow… I found you.

We met unexpectedly on an app. Neither of us was looking for love. I sent a message, you replied, and somehow a random conversation became a friendship, then a best friendship, and eventually something much bigger.

From strangers to best friends to boyfriend… I still think it's one of the sweetest unexpected things that happened to me.

03 · A LETTER TO SEONY

My favorite person.

My Seony, Happy birthday, my love. 🤍 Sometimes I still think about how unexpected everything between us was. I wasn't looking for love, and you weren't looking for it either. We were just two people who happened to meet on an app. And I'm still so thankful that I decided to message you—and even more thankful that you replied. We started as strangers. Then we became friends, then best friends. You became my suitor for a short while, even though you didn't want to admit you wanted that role for very long. 😭 And somehow, after all of that, you became my boyfriend. And now, when I think about my future, I don't just see you as my boyfriend. I see you as the man I want to marry. I know you're not perfect. I'm not perfect either. But I don't want a perfect person. I want you. You're the first person who has made me feel loved in a way I've never experienced before. You have shown me a kind of love that makes me feel safe, appreciated, and cared for. There are so many kilometers between the Philippines and Korea right now, and I hate that I can't be beside you to celebrate your birthday. I wish I could hug you, look at you, annoy you a little, and tell you in person how much you mean to me. But until that day comes, I hope this little gift reminds you that there is someone on the other side of the world thinking about you and loving you. Thank you for replying to that random message. Thank you for becoming my best friend. Thank you for choosing me. And thank you for letting me imagine a future with you. Happy birthday, My Seony. I hope this new year of your life brings you happiness, good health, beautiful memories, and everything you've been wishing for. And selfishly, I hope I get to be there for many of those memories. One day, I don't want to celebrate your birthday through a screen. I want to be beside you. Happy birthday to the man I love and the man Im gonna marry with someday. I love you. 🤍 — your girl, from the Philippines to Korea
04 · A BLESSING FOR YOU

What I pray for you.

On your birthday, this is one of the things I pray for you. I pray that God protects you wherever you go, guides you in every decision you make, gives you strength when life becomes difficult, and fills your life with peace and happiness. And I pray that, if it's His will, I get to be beside you through many more birthdays to come.

“The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.”
Numbers 6:24–26 (NIV)
05 · OUR SONG

A song that reminds me of you.

Because we weren't looking for love… and somehow we found each other.

Until I Found You — Stephen Sanchez

listen on YouTube ♡
06 · BETWEEN TWO COUNTRIES

Until the distance becomes smaller.

🇵🇭 PHILIPPINES   ─────────   🇰🇷 KOREA

There are kilometers between us right now, but they don't change how much you mean to me. Until we can celebrate birthdays in the same place, I'll keep sending my love across the distance.

07 · ONE DAY

A future I hope for.

One day... I don't want to send you birthday wishes through a screen. I don't want kilometers between us. I don't want to celebrate you from another country. I want to wake up next to you. I want to annoy you on your birthday. I want to buy your cake. I want to hug you. I want to be there for all the ordinary birthdays after this one. Until then, I'll keep loving you from here. 🇵🇭 ♡ 🇰🇷 Happy birthday,My Seony. My boyfriend, my best friend, and my partner in crime. — your girl 🤍
made with love for Seony ♡
